verdict.rationale: A government registration service could plausibly publish bulk datasets or statistics, so this axis applies. The evidence only shows a script-only application shell at the root and a 404 on the legacy entry path. Nothing documents any bulk download, registry extract or statistical dataset.

support.subject: As a developer, the service publishes bulk public-data downloads or extracts (datasets, registry extracts, wage or case statistics) that need no scraping
